title: Build: --kinds (pooled list) + a floor-only grading arm in macro_event_study_run.py, so the unconditional announcement-day premium (Savor-Wilson 2013) can be tested at power
note: Family: macro (A, docs/research/idea-family-review-2026-10-16.md). Savor & Wilson 2013 JFQA: 11.4 bps excess on announcement days vs 1.1 bps otherwise. Never tested here (searched queue/docs/scripts/comms for savor / announcement-day / pre-FOMC). One kind (~139 monthly releases) cannot reach t>=2 at ~11 bps on ~1% daily sd; pooled cpi_mom+nfp+ppi_mom+fomc (~550 days) can. The PPI sign book lost to all-long partly because 69/140 PPI windows contain CPI or FOMC within 5 days -- the long floor is collecting this premium. FIRST STEP: accept a comma list in --kind (dedupe by date) and add --grade floor (mean/t of the all-long release-day book vs a -6 td placebo), then author the unit (choose pre-2021, confirm post-2021). Pre-FOMC drift is NOT the target: Kurov-Wolfe-Gilbert 2021 show it vanished after 2015.
